title: Safeguarding Patient Outcomes - The Critical Role of Voltage Regulation in Healthcare and Life Sciences Equipment
summary: Whether it’s the precision of surgical lasers, the clarity of images from a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan or the detection of molecules in liquids, advanced medical and life science systems that enable better patient outcomes through healthcare diagnostics and treatment all have one thing in common - the need for stable system voltages. Advanced Energy has been developing customizable and modular power supplies for medical applications for almost 40 years, and is at the forefront of delivering power supply technologies essential to ensuring optimized performance and tightly regulated outputs across the spectrum of healthcare technologies.
